## Adding a New Tool

### 1. Data

Sample files under `inst/extdata/<tool>/` (\~10 rows + header is enough). Track
with [DVC] (see `vignette("devnotes")`).

### 2. Schema

Generate a skeleton `schema.yaml` from the sample files:

```r
use("nemo")
use("here", "here")
use("glue", "glue")
use("tibble", "tribble")

tool <- "mytool"
d1 <- here(glue("inst/extdata/{tool}/latest"))

x <- tribble(
  ~name    , ~descr                , ~pat                        , ~type , ~path                                      ,
  "table1" , "table1 description." , "\\.mytool\\.table1\\.tsv$" , "tsv" , file.path(d1, "sampleA.mytool.table1.tsv") ,
  "table2" , "table2 description." , "\\.mytool\\.table2\\.csv$" , "csv" , file.path(d1, "sampleA.mytool.table2.csv") ,
)

out <- here(glue("inst/config/tools/{tool}/schema.yaml"))
config_prep_write(config_prep_multi(x), out)
```

Raw names and types are auto-detected. Fill in by hand:

- `tidy`: `snake_case` output name
- `description`: from the tool's docs
- `versions`: tool versions the column appears in, e.g. `['v1.2.3', 'latest']`

If one file holds several tables (a stats header plus a histogram, a JSON with
several sections), keep the file's raw `columns:` and declare each table under
`outputs:` with its tidy columns. A file read by its own `parse_<table>()`
(JSON, multi-section, configurable columns) may omit `columns:`. Name the schema
table after the file and the outputs after their content; for a wide pivot whose
columns depend on the data, set `shape: 'subset'` on the output.

Schema format: see [Structure].

### 3. Parsers

Copy `R/Tool1.R` to `R/<Tool>.R`: `initialize()`, per-table `parse_*()` /
`tidy_*()`, roxygen with `@testexamples`.

- Method names must match a schema table (`tidy_table3()` for `table3`); `Tool`
  errors on construction otherwise.
- A table with `outputs:` needs a `tidy_<table>()` returning one tibble per
  output via `nemo_enframe()`, keyed by output name (see `Tool1$tidy_table7()`).
  `Tool` checks the columns and types of each against the schema on every tidy.

[DVC]: <https://github.com/iterative/dvc> "Data Version Control"
[Structure]: <https://tidywf.github.io/nemo/articles/structure.html> "Structure"
